title: Dashte Gurbat May Na Yunn Chhod ke Jao Abbas
body:
Dashte gurbat may na yunn chhod ke jao Abbas
Rookay kehtey thhay ye Sarwar na rulao Abbas
1. Kistarha doon tujhe marne ki ijazat bhai
Tere hi dam se hai shabbir ko quwwat bhai phir kahan paaounga mai teri mohabbat bhai
Apne bhai ko zara tum hi batao Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kyun kamar baandhe ho aada pa chadhayii ke liye
Haan magar tumko na jaana hai ladayii ke liye
Baazu katwana hai ummat ki bhalayii ke liye
Meri bataon se magar dil na dukhao Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Yeh na sooncha ke tere baad mera kya hoga aur kuch dair may Akbar bhi rawana hoga
Koun shabbir ki peeri ka sahara hoga
Kaise du’n tumko riza itna batao Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Mere bhai mere lashkar ke alamdar ho tum
Haq me Zainab ke liye Hyder e karrar ho tum aur bekas ke gharibon ke madadgaar ho tum
Kya mai Zainab ko bataon ye batao Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tere marne se kunba paresha’n hoga
Bekasi hoyegi or dashte gharibaa’n hoga
Koun phir chadar e Zainab ka nigehbaa’n hoga
Apni behnou’n pe zara rahem tou khao Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bhai ko rootay huway chhod ke kya jaaogey
Waswasey aatay hain tum lout ke na aaogey
Meri minnat pa bhi kya rahem nahi khaogey
Kaise main tumko manao’n ye batao Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Moosvi kahte thay ghazi se shaihey koun o makaan
Saat battees baras hii ka tha aye rahate jaan t
Um bichad jao tou phir zeest ka imkaan kahan
Meri gurbat pa taras khao na jao Abbas
Azz: mustafa moosvi.
